# basic-setting

Fix decode_basic(text) to decode one single-line TOML basic string, including its double-quote delimiters. Use the escape table and valid Unicode scalar rule in the document; reject reserved escapes and invalid scalar escapes with ValueError. Inputs have balanced outer quotes and no trailing TOML tokens. Multi-line and literal strings are outside scope. Python 3.12 standard library, including tomllib, is allowed.

Run: `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests`.
Source: https://toml.io/en/v1.0.0 (String: Basic strings, escape table, and reserved escape paragraph).
Preserve the interface and tests. No dependencies; scratch data only in the system temporary directory.
